title: Municipality | Politics and Government | Research Starters | EBSCO Research
content: A municipality is a defined urban area, such as a city or town, that operates as a single political entity with its own local administration. It serves as a fundamental unit of local government in many countries and is subject to varied definitions based on each nation’s governance structure. The powers, rights, and geographical scope of municipalities can greatly differ; for instance, in some nations, municipalities may encompass entire city-states like Monaco, while in others, they could consist of just a portion of a city, as seen in the City of London.
